objective: Produce a read-only per-step divergence report between two traces of the same scenario, keeping each environment class separate and distinguishing divergence from non-execution.
decision_supported: Can a reviewer see where two environment traces disagree? Not without reading both logs by hand, and no artifact separated a disagreement from a run that never executed.
acceptance: Each trace keeps its own environment class in the report.
A divergent step names the fields that differ and both values.
Identity fields are not reported as divergence.
A trace with no events is reported as never executed, not as agreement.
The report is bounded and states when it truncated.
stop_conditions: The change would certify sim-to-real equivalence.
risks_and_fallbacks: The report is a pointer, not a proof: it names where to look and does not certify equivalence.
